ground_truth: Fill expert 1's optic-disc outline to make a mask at the original image size.
prompt_rule: Choose positive clicks from the consensus mask. The first click is the foreground pixel farthest from the boundary. Each later click is the remaining foreground pixel farthest from the earlier clicks. Smaller prompts use the first points of the three-click prompt.
